{{Quote|OOM-9, your first objective is to take out the system jamming device so we can land reinforcements within the city.|Nute Gunray's orders to OOM-9|audio=TheedJammer.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
A '''signal jammer''' was located in [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. It was able to prevent hostile [[Starship/Legends|starships]] from entering the city. In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], it was destroyed by the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Trade Federation Droid Army]] under the command of the [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droid]] [[OOM-9/Legends|OOM-9]] to coordinate the [[Capture of Theed/Legends|capture]] of Theed.

==Description==
{{Quote|The battle droid army is going for the systems jammer!|A royal trooper during the Fall of Theed|<ref name="GB" />}}
A signal jammer was located in the northeast section of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of<ref name="GB" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. It was capable of blocking [[Starship/Legends|starships]] from landing within the city limits. The [[Jammer/Legends|jammer]] itself consisted of a rotating pole that held up a [[Color/Legends|black]] panel, all on top of a paved brick base. The device was guarded by two medium-strength [[Turret/Legends|turrets]] on its sides and was surrounded by residential buildings, [[Power generator/Legends|power stations]], and a [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]].<ref name="GB" />

==History==
{{Quote|The jammer is destroyed.|OOM-9|audio=JammerDown.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
[[File:Jammer_attack.png|thumb|right|300px|The jammer under attack]]
In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] and its [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Droid Army]] [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invaded]] Naboo and sought to [[Capture of Theed/Legends|capture]] Theed. The signal jammer prevented any hostile forces from landing within the city, so the [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]] assigned the [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droid]] [[OOM-9/Legends|OOM-9]] to deal with the jammer. OOM-9 breached Theed's gates with an elite [[Battalion/Legends|battalion]], including two [[Energy pummel/Legends|energy pummels]], eight [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tanks]], OOM-9's [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Heavy Armored Assault Tank]], three manned [[Single Trooper Aerial Platform/Legends|Single Trooper Aerial Platforms]], and fifteen [[Heavy Battle Droid/Legends|Heavy Battle Droids]].<ref name="GB" />

The [[Battle droid/Legends|droids]] fought through pockets of resistance from the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] to reach the jammer. After crossing one of the city's bridges, a [[Security Guard/Legends|royal trooper]] realized that the [[Army/Legends|army]] was targeting the jammer.<ref name="GB" /> When the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] reached the jammer's location, OOM-9 sent a [[Energy pummel/Legends|pummel]] to destroy the turrets first, after which the rest of his forces destroyed the hangar and the signal jammer,<ref name="Prima">[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref> allowing more reinforcements to land within the city and conquer it.<ref name="GB" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Theed signal jammer was first mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]'' by [[Steven L. Kent]],<ref name="Prima">[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref>&mdash;released on [[November 7]], [[2001]]<ref name="PrimaDate">{{Amazon|url=dp/0761537503|text=Star Wars Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide}}</ref>&mdash;before appearing in the [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'',<ref name="GB" /> released on [[November 11]], 2001.<ref name="GBDate">{{GameSpot|url=games/star-wars-galactic-battlegrounds|text=Star Wars Galactic Battlegrounds}}</ref> The jammer appears in "Capturing the Crown," the fourth level of the Trade Federation campaign, in which the device is the player's first target as they control the Trade Federation Droid Army.<ref name="GB" />
